correctionHistory.limits: Four full research abstracts read; no movement-specific scientific source fully read for every exercise. Static 2D/AI inspection cannot establish exact joint angles, dynamic control or individual safety.

handAcceptanceCriteria: Identify exact intended grip: pronated, supinated, neutral or other. Do not infer it from exercise name alone.
Inspect both hands enlarged: palms and backs agree with intended grip, thumb wraps opposite fingers, no bar penetration, implausible digits or abrupt wrist bend.
Compare both positions: same attachment, hand spacing and grip; inspect hand-to-forearm continuity.
Occluded or ambiguous contact is not evidence of a correct grip. Withhold when the grip cannot be reasonably assessed.
Image generation and software tests are not anatomical approval. Record rejected alternatives and retain limitations.
bodyAcceptanceCriteria: Describe the illustrated movement phase before judging joint angles.
Check head/neck continuity, trunk/pelvis position, visible support points, load path, attachment and grip together.
Do not assign exact 3D joint degrees from an uncalibrated perspective image.
Distinguish natural individual variation from a clear mechanical mismatch. Do not require universal squat depth, stance or elbow angle.
Inspect each active exact-ID image only. Retired atlas cells are not approved and must not reappear.
A static setup thumbnail is not a complete repetition demonstration.
Record independent AI disagreement and withhold unresolved misleading images. AI review and software checks are not professional certification.
independentReviewStatus: Five independent AI role reviews completed; specific findings resolved or withheld. Follow-up crop/placeholder checks documented. No licensed expert certification.
